## Agent 4: editor
**The main editor is an external worker** (Claude Opus in the author's setup, since 2026-11-12): the draft is parked in the table `blog_edit_requests`, an editor service outside n8n edits it and writes it back, and this workflow checks once a minute. Only if the worker has not answered after 20 minutes (or its edit failed) does the qwq editor below run as the fallback.

Started by Agent 3 (answers at once). qwq fallback brief: fact-check against the research, drop unlisted links, cut filler, fix structure, keep the voice. It edits **section by section** (one model call per `##` section; a whole-post edit made qwq summarise instead of edit). The model call is the single node **Editor Model Call (swap here)** (today qwq:32b): a replacement takes each item's prompt and returns `{response}` per item. If any section's edit fails, the writer's text is kept for it and `editorOk=false`, so Agent 5 HOLDS the post (alert, no publish).

**Dry run:** start from Agent 1 with `{"dryRun": true}`.
